title: Shoemaker’s Dream Shoe Houses The Christmas Shoe Figurine By John Herbert 1991
descriptionText: "The Shoemaker's Dream Shoe Houses: The Christmas Shoe Figurine by John Herbert 1991 is a collectible decorative figurine perfect for the Christmas season. Created by Studios and Workshops of John Hine, this unique piece features intricate details and craftsmanship that bring a festive touch to any space. This figurine is a charming addition to any holiday decor and a must-have for collectors of unique and whimsical sculptures."
